basic_details.scholarship_name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program for Pakistan
basic_details.offering_entity: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP) & U.S. Department of State (ECA)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Selected Host Campuses (MIT, Syracuse University, Cornell University, UC Davis, Emory, Boston University, Penn State, Vanderbilt)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Public policy and leadership fields: Public Health, Climate Change & Environmental Policy, Economic Development, Banking & Finance, Journalism & Communications, Educational Administration, Law and Human Rights, Public Administration, Technology Policy.
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: ~10 to 15 mid-career leaders selected from Pakistan annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 10 months of combined graduate study, leadership seminars, and professional affiliation

nationality_requirements: Pakistani citizens residing in Pakistan throughout application process
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants are typically mid-career professionals between 30 and 50 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of formal education (4-year Bachelor's or 2-year Bachelor's + 2-year Master's) from an HEC-recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum second division (50% marks) or 2.5 / 4.00 CGPA; substantive career leadership record carries primary weight.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantive experience in designated Humphrey public service fields.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Employed mid-career professional; university students are NOT eligible.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Minimum 5 years of full-time substantive professional experience in public service, government, NGO, media, or private sector leadership with demonstrated public impact.

english_proficiency.notes: No test needed to apply; shortlisted finalists take USEFP-funded TOEFL iBT.

eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; women and public sector officers from remote regions strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Public commitment, demonstrated leadership trajectory, policy influence potential.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Recent extensive U.S. study/experience (within past 7 years) renders applicants lower priority.

tuition_fee.details: Tuition and academic fees at assigned host U.S. university paid directly.

admission_application_fee.details: Managed directly via USEFP and Institute of International Education (IIE).

accommodation.details: Fellows arrange apartments using generous monthly living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Comprehensive monthly maintenance allowance based on host city cost of living.

airfare.details: Round-trip international economy class airfare from Pakistan to the United States.

visa_fee.details: J-1 visa sponsorship, SEVIS fees, and visa fees fully covered.

health_insurance.details: ASPE health coverage provided by U.S. Department of State.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Textbook and professional equipment allowance provided upon arrival.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Professional development grant ($2,000–$3,000) for domestic U.S. conferences and professional affiliation field trips.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Settlement allowance and domestic travel in Pakistan covered.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host campuses designated by IIE into thematic cohorts.
participating_institutions: MIT (Special Program for Urban & Regional Studies)
Emory University (Rollins School of Public Health)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier Ivy League and leading U.S. public policy faculties.
available_majors: Public Policy, Public Health, Climate Change, Environmental Policy, Economic Development, Financial Crimes & Banking, Educational Leadership, Law & Human Rights, Technology Policy
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Placement coordinated centrally by IIE; no independent university application required.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Host campuses are assigned based on your designated professional focus.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus heavily on how the 6-week professional affiliation in a U.S. agency, think tank, or multinational NGO will enable policy innovation in Pakistan.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the USEFP portal, complete career history, and upload institutional endorsements.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Complete online application on USEFP portal (Open: March/April, Deadline: early June).
2. Submit detailed Professional Goals Essay and Program Plan.
3. Secure employer endorsement letter confirming leave of absence.
4. Provide three professional and academic letters of reference.
5. Panel interviews held in Islamabad/Karachi in August/September.
6. National nominees forwarded to J. William Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board (FSB) in Washington.
7. Final approval released in February/March; departure in August.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by supervisors and professional mentors.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Address your professional goals, public service impact in Pakistan, leadership challenges faced, and how the Humphrey program aligns with institutional reform.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Program Plan detailing specific graduate coursework, leadership seminars, and prospective U.S. organizations for the 6-week professional affiliation.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Comprehensive professional resume (3-4 pages) detailing career progression, publications, and reform achievements.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute structured panel interview before U.S. diplomats, senior civil servants, and Humphrey alumni in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT taken and funded by USEFP for shortlisted candidates only.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC attested degree and transcripts required prior to final grant confirmation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translations required if certificates are in Urdu.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official service certificates verifying minimum 5 years full-time substantive employment
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From employer HR departments or government department heads

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official letter from current employer approving 10 months study leave
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for civil servants and public sector employees

required_documents_checklist.specification: Professional and academic references speaking to leadership ability
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From direct supervisors, department secretaries, or institutional directors

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Opens annually in April and closes early June; final selection confirmed by Washington in March of following year.

selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 40% (Track record of public leadership, community initiatives, and public sector reforms)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clear roadmap for applying knowledge upon return)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: USEFP executive leadership, senior U.S. Embassy public diplomacy officers, and Pakistani Humphrey alumni.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Identification of committed leaders who will return to Pakistan and lead positive systemic change in their institutions.

competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 2.80 to 3.80 / 4.00 CGPA (Grades secondary to career track record)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Assistant commissioners, directors in provincial departments, senior journalists, healthcare administrators, climate policy experts.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Civil servants, judicial officers, NGO founders, environmental advocates, and broadcast media heads.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial career coaches charging exorbitant fees to write Humphrey program plans.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: USEFP application is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through third-party agents; direct candidate engagement is mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Domestic travel to Islamabad for interview and pre-departure sessions.
Passport issuance and NADRA document certification fees.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You receive a Master's degree. (Fact: Humphrey is a non-degree professional development program; participants receive a Certificate of Completion issued by the President of the United States and host university).
MYTH: You can stay in the USA for immigration. (Fact: Fellows are subject to the strict two-year home residency requirement (212(e)) on J-1 visa).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some career websites mistake this for an academic PhD grant; it is strictly a professional leadership fellowship.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must satisfactorily complete all enrolled courses and seminars with passing grades.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence, complete attendance at national Humphrey seminars, and 6-week professional affiliation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Monthly check-ins and performance reporting by university coordinator to IIE.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Paid employment outside the fellowship is strictly prohibited under J-1 visa rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY 2-Year Home Country Physical Presence Requirement (J-1 Section 212(e)); cannot change visa status or immigrate to U.S. until 2 years spent in Pakistan.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligated to return to sponsoring employer or public service in Pakistan.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failure to complete program, early departure, or violation of U.S. laws entails termination and repayment of fellowship costs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: University assignment is fixed and cannot be changed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions beyond the 10-month grant period are strictly prohibited.
